UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the authenticated clinical operator profile at a PHC or Arogya Mandir.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the clinical operator.

displayName.description: Full name of the clinical operator.

role.description: Role in PHC: MO (Medical Officer) or ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife).

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Patient.title: Patient
Patient.description: Patient demographic, ABHA profile, and chronic condition record.

userId.description: Auth UID of the operator who created/manages this patient record.

abhaNumber.description: 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account ID in XX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format (e.g. 91-4432-8810-1209).

encryptedAbha.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted ABHA number for secure storage.

abhaBlindIndex.description: Deterministic HMAC-SHA256 blind index hash for zero-knowledge indexed search.

isPregnant.description: High-risk pregnancy flag for maternal triage.

phone.description: Patient or family mobile phone number.

activeMedications.description: Existing medications for chronic conditions (e.g. Warfarin, Metformin).

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Encounter.title: Encounter
Encounter.description: Clinical encounter event with triage classification, SOAP note, NCERx e-prescription, and NHCX claim data.

userId.description: Auth UID of the clinician logging the encounter.

patientId.description: Reference to the patient being evaluated.

triageRationale.description: Clinical rationale explaining the triage urgency.

referralRequired.description: Flag for immediate tertiary hospital referral advisory.

rawVoiceTranscript.description: Raw Telugu/Hindi/English code-switching voice transcript or clinical notes.

fhirBundleJson.description: HL7 FHIR R4 ClinicalImpression and MedicationRequest resource bundle.

vitalsSummary.description: Summary string of vitals (BP, SpO2, Pulse, Temp, Sugar).

heartRate.description: Pulse / heart rate in beats per minute.

prescribedMedications.description: Generic medication regimens advised (e.g. Metformin 500mg BD).

syncedNhcx.description: Flag indicating successful upload to National Health Claims Exchange.

syncedFhir.description: Flag indicating successful sync to ABDM FHIR gateway.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/patients/{patientId}.description: Per-operator patient directory with ABHA IDs.

/users/{userId}/encounters/{encounterId}.description: Clinical encounter records with triage, SOAP notes, and sync status.
